description: Plan, code, render, and verify Manim animations, with optional SandBase image, narration, music, and transcription assets.

requires: A local Manim environment for rendering
An authorized SandBase connection only for optional generated media

install.prompt: Use $manim-animator to plan, code, render, and verify this explanatory animation.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill manim-animator --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill manim-animator --agent codex --global

examples: Animate a geometric proof with equations that transform between steps.
Create a narrated explanation of gradient descent and verify the final MP4.
Build a three-scene scientific animation with one generated background image.

required.label: Compatible Python and Manim runtime for rendering

optional_inputs: duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and frame rate
existing Manim project and framework choice
authorized SandBase connection for generated media

notes: Manim code and vector rendering are local and do not require SandBase.
Optional AI media uses dynamically discovered SandBase capabilities with cost confirmation.
Do not mix Manim Community and ManimGL APIs in one project.
Verify low-quality previews before final rendering.

endpoints.summary: Discover current image and audio-generation capabilities.
Inspect live media schemas, formats, timing controls, limits, and pricing.
Execute an approved image, speech, music, effect, or transcription model.
Recover recent run status and actual cost.
Check balance before a multi-call media batch.
